description: Add import parsers for 8 major Bitcoin exchanges plus a native format, enabling users to onboard transaction history via CLI
principles: Bitcoin-only focus - all parsers filter to BTC transactions
Consistent output format - all parsers return (colnames, transactions) tuple
Sensible defaults - withdrawal handling with review comments
Extensible registry - easy to add new parsers

userStories.title: Base importer class and registry
acceptanceCriteria: Create imports/base.py with BaseImporter abstract class:
- parse(file_path: str, withdraw_to: str | None) -> tuple[list[str], list[dict]] abstract method
- detect(file_path: str) -> bool method for auto-detection
- register(cls) decorator to register parser classes
Export from imports/__init__.py: BaseImporter, register, get_parser, get_all_parsers, detect_parser
Unit tests for registry: register, get, detect operations

userStories.title: Transaction validation utilities
acceptanceCriteria: validate_transaction(tx: dict) -> list[str] returns list of error messages:
- Check required fields: trans_type, created_date, exchange
- Check trans_type is valid: Trade, Deposit, Withdrawal, Interest Income, Mining
- Check buy/sell fields based on trans_type
ValidationResult dataclass: valid_count, error_count, warnings, errors
- Check for existing transactions by date + exchange + amount + type
Unit tests with various error scenarios

userStories.title: CLI entry point (import_csv script)
acceptanceCriteria: --list: Show all available parsers with descriptions
--format NAME: Show expected CSV format for parser
FILE: Positional argument for CSV file path
2. If --format: print format help and exit
3. Validate file exists and is readable
Integration tests with sample CSV and in-memory SQLite

userStories.title: Native format parser
acceptanceCriteria: Also accepts legacy export format: Type,Buy,Buy Cur.,Sell,Sell Cur.,Fee,Fee Cur.,Exchange,Group,Comment,Date
Map columns to standard transaction dict format

userStories.title: Coinbase parser
acceptanceCriteria: Parse columns: Timestamp, Transaction Type, Asset, Quantity Transacted, Spot Price Currency, Spot Price at Transaction, Subtotal, Total, Fees, Notes
- Rewards Income / Learning Reward -> Interest Income
For Send: set exchange to withdraw_to or '{Exchange}-Withdrawal', add review comment

userStories.title: Kraken parser
acceptanceCriteria: Parse Kraken ledger format (13 columns): txid, refid, time, type, subtype, aclass, asset, amount, fee, balance
Handle Kraken asset naming: XXBT -> BTC, XBT -> BTC
- trade -> Trade (match buy/sell pairs by refid)
- Identify buy leg (positive amount) and sell leg (negative amount)
Extensive unit tests for pair matching edge cases

userStories.title: Strike parser
acceptanceCriteria: Map transaction types: purchases, sends, receives
Extract purchase price for cost basis

userStories.title: River parser
acceptanceCriteria: 1. Bitcoin Activity CSV: BTC transactions only
2. Account Activity CSV: All account activity
Auto-detect format based on column headers

userStories.title: Cash App parser
acceptanceCriteria: Handle limitation: no cost basis for external transfers
Generate warning for external receives with $0 basis

userStories.title: Gemini parser
acceptanceCriteria: Parse Gemini transaction history: time, base-asset, quote-asset, type, price, quantity, total, fee, fee-currency, trade-id
Map transaction types including Gemini Earn interest

userStories.title: Fold parser
acceptanceCriteria: Parse Fold Yearly Bitcoin Transaction History
Map reward transactions to Interest Income
